facts.text: Deborah started a yoga class in her neighborhood, which she hosts for her neighbors.

evidence.quote: I started this yoga class in the neighborhood - it's such a good feeling! Now I get to share the exercise with my neighbors and watch it really transform them.
My neighbors were interested in trying yoga, so I hosted a class for them on Friday.

facts.text: Deborah hosted a yoga class for her neighbors on Friday, which was well-received by the participants.

evidence.quote: My neighbors were interested in trying yoga, so I hosted a class for them on Friday. It was great to see everyone embrace and enjoy it.

facts.text: Deborah shared a photo of the group of women who participated in the yoga class.

evidence.quote: Here is our photo together. [image: a photo of a group of women posing for a picture]
